summaries.n-gta6-launch-coins: Coins named for Grand Theft Auto VI. Rockstar Games posted on 2025-11-06 that the game will release on Thursday, November 19, 2026, and on 2026-11-12 that it is one week away; traders' recaps of 2026-11-14 and 2026-11-15 say GTA coins are trending. Twenty-eight coins are members, each with GTA in its name or description: WASTED ("the iconic GTA death screen"), GTA6CAT, GTA Dollars, Ah shit, here we go again. ("The most iconic GTA meme of all time, with GTA 6 coming out"), gtacoin (LaunchLab; "the one coin for all of gta"), Macca The Gator ("GTA 6 Mascot"), State of Leonida ("The home state of GTA VI"), Peekhole ("a parody of OnlyFans inside GTA 6"), GTA memes, Jason Duval (named for a GTA VI protagonist; it says holders earn $TTWO stock, which is not verified here), Bawsaq (GTA's fictional stock exchange, "from the world of GTA 6"), Rocco, EEAGLE and Mission Passed (from 2026-11-06), and, from 2026-11-16, GRAND THEFT CRYPTO ("The first GTA server with real cryptocurrency"; its account describes a GTA-style role-play server, not verified here), Doug The Frog ("the frog... from Macca the Gator..., the cartoon inside GTA 6") and Cyber Dacity Coin ("GTA-inspired chaos to neon Miami"), and, from 2026-11-17, three coins named for BAWSAQ, the games' fictional stock exchange: Vice City Index ("BAWSAQ is the GTA VI stock index on Solana") on Pump.fun and a Meteora DBC copy of the same name, and Vice City Bawsaq; Leonida Games ("Built for the players waiting on Leonida"); Grand Theft Anthropic (symbol GTA, a pun that posts call GTA-inspired); and Here We Go Again (symbol GTAVI); and, from 2026-11-18, the day before the release, Jason & Lucia ("celebrating the GTA VI duo"; it says it is unofficial), Official Grand Theft Auto VI (its own name; nothing shows it is official), GTA Vice Inu, Grand Trench Agency (symbol GTA, "living the vice-city life", "not affiliated with any game"), The State of Leonida and WANTED ("WANTED GTA 6 6STARS"). All but gtacoin (LaunchLab) and the Meteora DBC Vice City Index are on Pump.fun. Dates from Codex: the GTA6CAT and GTA memes pools opened in late August 2026, Macca The Gator, Jason Duval, Peekhole, EEAGLE and WASTED in October, WANTED on 2026-11-04, and the other twenty between 2026-11-05 and 2026-11-18, all ahead of the release. Mission Passed is archived (under $1,000 of 24h volume on two consecutive observations; its membership stays open). Coins named only for the in-game Dacity Coin brand are a separate narrative (GTA 6 Dacity Coin coins). None of the coins is shown to be connected to Rockstar Games or Take-Two. Measured: twenty-seven coins across all their pools.
summaries.n-gta6-dacity-coin: Coins named for Dacity Coin and AudaCity, a fictional coin brand that posts say appears in Grand Theft Auto VI material. On 2026-10-11 the account @robtmb1 posted that a GTA 6 leak shows a meme coin called "Dacity Coin"; the first Dacity Coin on Pump.fun was created 35 seconds later. On 2026-11-10 Rockstar posted a pre-load trailer; its post does not name the coin, and posts since then say AudaCity boxes, a billboard and DacityCoin appear in Rockstar's footage and argue over which coin is the "right" one. On 2026-11-18, the day before the release, posts debate an anonymous claim that the in-game ticker is $DCI, and the exchange Bitrue posted that it lists a DACITYCOIN/USDT perpetual, "A Solana meme coin inspired by GTA VI". Twelve coins are members, all on Solana. Collected: on Pump.fun, Dacity Coin (token created 2026-10-11), AudaCity (symbol DacityCoin) and DacityCoin (2026-10-15), DacityCoin with the symbol DACITY (2026-10-15), DTC (2026-10-20) and DAC (2026-10-24), and, from 2026-11-18, two DacityCoin coins with the symbol DCI (pools opened 2026-11-12 and 2026-11-13). Archived (under $1,000 of 24h volume on two consecutive observations; memberships stay open): GTAVI AudaCity on Pump.fun and three Meteora DBC AudaCity copies. Most have empty descriptions, so their names carry the claim. What the footage shows was not checked here, the ticker claims are unverified, and none of the coins is shown to be affiliated with Rockstar or Take-Two. Collection was paused from 2026-11-16 to 2026-11-18 at the six-narrative cap. Measured: eight coins across all their pools.
